<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
# Security Assessment: basalt-inference-git PKGBUILD

This is a conventional AUR PKGBUILD for a CUDA-based local inference engine tracking upstream `main` at github.com/jesdga95/basalt.

- The VCS source uses `sha256sums=('SKIP')`, which is required and normal for `-git` packages.
- `prepare()` applies two local patch files from `$source` using `git am --3way`; it does not fetch from the network and aborts cleanly if a patch fails to apply.
- `build()` runs CMake/Ninja locally with an explicit CUDA toolkit path (`/opt/cuda`) and adjusts CXXFLAGS to work around an upstream `libstdc++` assertion bug (issue #224). No code is downloaded or executed from external hosts.
- `package()` installs binaries, Python server code, and data files into `/usr/lib/basalt`, creates qualified `/usr/bin` symlinks to avoid collisions with unrelated `basalt` packages, and verifies the patches are present in installed binaries.

No exfiltration, reverse shells, obfuscated code, `eval`/`base64`/`curl|bash`, or unrelated system modifications are present.
</details>
<evidence>
